algorithm: Within each cell retain candidates with minimum unscored model-task count; then 32 deterministic seeded starts and coordinate ascent, one scene per cell; capped coverage minus modest cost/infrastructure penalties
objective_claim: heuristic local optimum, not a proof of global optimality
cost_proxy_only: Unobserved/provider-error rows use model x difficulty medians solely for selection cost, never for reported outcomes/cost totals
